caption: The drawing depicts a square textile object, such as a quilt or coverlet, with one corner folded over to show multiple layers. The primary design in the central section features a symmetrical floral pattern composed of four red, petal-like clusters arranged around a small, empty square at the very center. Radiating out from these clusters are four large green leaf motifs, each curving outward and separating the central design into four quadrants. Within each quadrant, there is a single stem with three yellow and red tulip-shaped flowers, each with green leaves. The background of the central section consists of a light, grid-like pattern filled with pale circular and geometric motifs. The main square is bordered by a thick band containing a feather-like or braided pattern, and a thinner, outermost edge outlined in red. The textile has a red edge that is visible along the folds on the left side, indicating the thickness and layered construction of the object. The colors include red, yellow, green, white, and pale gray, with the red edging and floral elements providing contrast against the white background.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
